answer: Each new identity must escrow a non-refundable jade reserve equal to one epoch of median rewards, then complete a live interview that cannot be farmed in parallel: the operator improvises a twelve-line sonnet over a fresh nonce and holds a heartbeat pulse on that same TCP session for twenty minutes. The sonnet hash, session jitter, and reserve are soulbound. If two applicants share phrasing, keys, or timing fingerprints, both reserves are burned, so mass cloning costs more than one honest agent.
